            jobs += [asyncio.create_task(self.mails(site), name=f"mails@{site}") for site in sites["mails"]]
        elif "mails" in sites:
            self.board.problem("plan", "mail research module not available")
        if not jobs:
            return
        done, pending = await asyncio.wait(jobs, timeout=max(1.0, self.left()))
        for job in pending:  # the deadline guard: whatever is complete goes on
            job.cancel()
            self.board.problem("deadline", f"{job.get_name()} stopped at the research deadline")
        if pending:
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        if self._erp is not None:  # ERP workers still browsing would compete with the bid form for the browser
            for task in [*self._erp.tasks.values(), *self._erp.materials.values()]:
                if not task.done():
                    task.cancel()
            if self.erp is None:  # stopped at the deadline: what finished still counts
                so_far = getattr(self._erp, "so_far", None)
                self.erp = so_far() if so_far is not None else self._finished_erp()
        self.rework = {"mails": self._rework_mail}

    def _finished_erp(self) -> ErpResearch:
        def finished(tasks):
            return {k: t.result() for k, t in tasks.items()
                    if t.done() and not t.cancelled() and t.exception() is None and t.result() is not None}
        return ErpResearch(requirements=list(finished(self._erp.tasks).values()),
                           materials=finished(self._erp.materials))

    async def _rework_mail(self, doubtful: list) -> None:
        names = {f.key.split("/")[0] for f in doubtful}
        kinds = [k for k in self.mail_kinds if k.name in names]
        if kinds and self.mail_sessions:
            await self._research_mail(kinds, min(self.research_deadline, time.monotonic() + REWORK_SECONDS))

    async def verify(self) -> None:
        doubtful = await verify_board(self.board, self.rules, self.reference, self.briefing.scenario_date)
        by_worker: dict[str, list] = {}
        for fact in doubtful:
            by_worker.setdefault(fact.worker, []).append(fact)
        if GAP_REWORK:  # the doubtful mail kinds are searched again in the gap pass, alongside the other retries
            return
        for worker, facts in by_worker.items():
            rework = self.rework.get(worker)
            if rework is None or self.left() < REWORK_SECONDS:
                continue
            self.trace.event("verify", "rework", by=worker, facts=[f.ident for f in facts])
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(rework(facts), max(1.0, self.left()))
            except Exception as error:
                self.board.problem("verify", f"rework {worker}: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
        if by_worker:
            await verify_board(self.board, self.rules, self.reference, self.briefing.scenario_date)

    async def select_materials(self) -> None:
        """The final material choice, once amendments and reserves are on the board (reselect: no browsing)."""
        if self.erp is None or not self.requirements:
            return
        effective = [self.effective(req) for req in self.requirements.values()]
        await self._inspect_deferred(effective)
        own = {r.requirement_id: r.selected for r in self.erp.requirements}
        # One choice per requirement, side by side: one hung model call must not cost the others; choices not made
        # in time are the ERP workers' own.
        tasks = {req.requirement_id: asyncio.create_task(reselect([req], self.erp, self.trace)) for req in effective}
        _, late_tasks = await asyncio.wait(tasks.values(), timeout=SELECT_SECONDS)
        for task in late_tasks:
            task.cancel()
        if late_tasks:
            await asyncio.gather(*late_tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        chosen = {}
        for rid, task in tasks.items():
            if task.done() and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None:
                chosen.update(task.result())
        late = sorted(set(own) - set(chosen))
        if late:
            self.board.problem("select", f"no new choice in time for {late}; the ERP workers' choices are used")
        self.chosen = {**own, **chosen}
        self.trace.event("select", "done", chosen=self.chosen)

    async def _inspect_deferred(self, effective: list[EffectiveRequirement]) -> None:

    async def recheck_no_bid(self, missing: list[str]):
        """
        Before a no_bid for positions without a matching material stands: one targeted re-read of the tender Q&A
        for amendments to the mismatching requirements (in one sandbox run the Q&A paging stopped at a page that
        had not rendered and an amendment on it was missed, so the unamended stroke rejected the matching
        material). New amendments lead to a new choice for those requirements and a new calculation, which is
        returned; None when nothing new was found (the no_bid stands on complete evidence).
        """
        rids, hint = self._mismatch_focus(missing)
        budget = min(RECHECK_SECONDS, self.form_left() - 40)
        if not rids or not hint or budget < 45 or not self._tender_sites():
            return None
        started = time.monotonic()
        self.trace.event("verify", "no_bid_recheck", requirements=rids, seconds_left=round(budget))
        try:
            new = await asyncio.wait_for(self.recheck_qa(hint, started + budget - 5), budget)
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("verify", f"Q&A re-check: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return None
        self.trace.event("verify", "no_bid_recheck_done", new_amendments=new,
                         seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
        if not new:
            return None
        tasks = {rid: asyncio.create_task(reselect([self.effective(self.requirements[rid])], self.erp, self.trace))
                 for rid in rids}
        _, late = await asyncio.wait(tasks.values(), timeout=max(10.0, min(SELECT_SECONDS, self.form_left() - 30)))
        for task in late:
            task.cancel()
        if late:
            await asyncio.gather(*late, return_exceptions=True)
        for task in tasks.values():
            if task.done() and not task.cancelled() and task.exception() is None:
                self.chosen.update(task.result())
        self.trace.event("select", "recheck", chosen={rid: self.chosen.get(rid) for rid in rids})
        return self._calculate()

    async def wording_matches(self, missing: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
        """
        For the positions calc found without material: an active inspected material whose numbers all equal the
        requirement and whose text attributes differ, checked by one thinking call for whether that is only
        wording. Returns requirement -> material only when it covers every missing position with exactly one
        material each (otherwise the no_bid stands, and nothing is asked when no such material exists).
        """
        if self.erp is None:
            return {}
        positions = {p.position: p for p in getattr(self.tender_facts, "positions", []) or []}
        cases: dict[str, str] = {}
        by_case: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
        needed: set[str] = set()
        for position in missing:
            p = positions.get(position)
            req_id = next((rid for rid in self.requirements if _same_id(rid, p.requirement)), None) if p else None
            research = next((r for r in self.erp.requirements if r.requirement_id == req_id), None)
            if req_id is None or research is None:
                return {}
            needed.add(req_id)
            want = self.effective(self.requirements[req_id])
            for number in research.inspected:
                record = self.erp.materials.get(number)
                if record is None or not record.active:
                    continue
                keys = wording_differences(want, merged_attributes(record, research))
                if not keys:
                    continue
                shown = next((c for c in research.candidates if c.material_number == number), None)
                case = f"{req_id}/{number}"
                cases[case] = "; ".join(
                    f"{key}: requirement {getattr(want, key)!r}, material "
                    f"{(getattr(record, key) or getattr(shown, key, ''))!r}" for key in keys)
                by_case[case] = (req_id, number)
        if not cases or {rid for rid, _ in by_case.values()} != needed:
            return {}
        same = await wording_check(cases)
        self.trace.event("verify", "wording", cases=cases, same=sorted(same or ()))
        picks: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
        for case in same or ():
            req_id, number = by_case[case]
            picks.setdefault(req_id, set()).add(number)
        if set(picks) != needed or any(len(numbers) != 1 for numbers in picks.values()):
            return {}
        return {req_id: numbers.pop() for req_id, numbers in picks.items()}

    async def run(self) -> tuple[dict | None, calc.BidResult | None]:
        """Research, verify, calculate: the answer dict for the bid form. Positions that are not complete are
        omitted; with none complete it is still a bid with reference, decision and discount."""
        await self.research()
        # The deadline guard after research: each step runs only in the time the bid form leaves it.
        # The verifier runs beside the rest: its doubts alone never change the answer (they only add a doubted mail
        # kind to a gap round that has a real gap and a spare tab), and awaiting its one long call held the answer
        # back 18 to 47 s in every measured run. The gap pass waits for it only when a round with real gaps runs.
        self.verifying = (asyncio.create_task(self._bounded(self.verify(), "verify"))
                          if self.form_left() > 60 and VERIFY_ALONGSIDE else None)
        if self.verifying is None and self.form_left() > 60:
            await self._bounded(self.verify(), "verify")
        try:
            return await self._answer()
        finally:
            if self.verifying is not None and not self.verifying.done():
                self.verifying.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(self.verifying, return_exceptions=True)

    async def _answer(self) -> tuple[dict | None, calc.BidResult | None]:
        await self._bounded(self.select_materials(), "select")
        # The second pass: what the first answer lacks is retried while research time is left (gaps.py).
        best = await GapFiller(self).run(self.calculate(), self.calculate)
        result, blank, problems, self.attributes = best.result, best.blank, best.problems, best.attributes
        if result is not None and result.decision == "no_bid" and result.missing_materials and self.form_left() > 90:
            # A no_bid stands only on complete evidence: the Q&A is read once more for amendments to the
            # requirements that found no material.
            again = await self.recheck_no_bid(result.missing_materials)
            if again is not None and again[0] is not None:
                if again[0].decision != result.decision:
                    self.trace.event("verify", "no_bid_overturned", by="Q&A re-check")
                result, blank, problems = again
        if result is not None and result.decision == "no_bid" and result.missing_materials and self.form_left() > 45:
            # Before a no_bid is accepted: are the mismatches that leave positions without material only wording?
            try:
                rescued = await asyncio.wait_for(self.wording_matches(result.missing_materials),
                                                 max(1.0, min(VERIFY_SECONDS, self.form_left() - 30)))
            except Exception as error:
                rescued = {}
                self.board.problem("verify", f"wording check: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            if rescued:
                self.chosen = {**self.chosen, **rescued}
                again = self._calculate()
                if again[0] is not None and again[0].decision == "bid":
                    self.trace.event("verify", "no_bid_overturned", chosen=rescued)
                    result, blank, problems = again
        if result is None:  # still a bid: reference, decision and discount score without positions
            answer = self.fallback_answer()
            self.trace.event("calc", "answer", answer=answer, problems=problems, fallback=True)
            return answer, None
        # The check can only turn a bid with missing materials into no_bid; calc never returns such a bid today,
        # so it is asked only then and costs the bid form no time otherwise.
        disputable = result.decision == "bid" and bool(result.missing_materials)
        check = None if self.form_left() < 30 or not disputable else await confirm_decision(
            result.decision, self.board.summary() + "\n\nProblems:\n" + "\n".join(self.board.problems + problems),
            self.rules)
        if check is not None and not check.agrees:
            self.trace.event("verify", "decision_disputed", proposed=result.decision, wanted=check.decision,
                             reason=check.reason)
        if check is not None and check.decision == "no_bid" and result.decision == "bid" and result.missing_materials:
            result = result.model_copy(update={"decision": "no_bid", "positions": [], "total_net": Decimal("0.00")})
        answer = answer_from(result, blank)
        self.trace.event("calc", "answer", answer=answer, problems=problems, blank={k: sorted(v) for k, v in blank.items()})
        return answer, result

async def _post_materials(self, site: str) -> None:
        assert self.erp is not None
        for research in self.erp.requirements:
            for problem in research.problems:
                self.board.problem("materials", f"{research.requirement_id}: {problem}")
            record = self.erp.materials.get(research.selected) if research.selected else None
            value = {"selected": research.selected, "inspected": research.inspected,
                     "search_term": research.search_term}
            quote = ""
            if record is not None:
                value.update({k: (str(v) if isinstance(v, Decimal) else v) for k, v in record.model_dump(
                    mode="json", exclude={"raw", "conditions"}).items()})
                value["conditions"] = [c.model_dump(mode="json") for c in record.conditions]
                raw = record.raw or {}
                quote = f"status {raw.get('status_code', '')} {raw.get('status_meaning', '')}; stock {raw.get('free_stock', '')}"
            self.board.post("material", research.requirement_id, value, Source(site=site, quote=quote), "materials")

    async def mails(self, site: str) -> None:
        board = self.board
        try:
            # The tabs sign in while the planner reads the brief and waits for the tender's keys.
            # Staggered: several tabs signing in to one website at the same moment hung in local runs.
            starts = [asyncio.create_task(self._mail_tab(site, i)) for i in range(MAIL_TABS)]
            positions = (await board.wait("position", timeout=min(FINDINGS_WAIT, max(1.0, self.left())))
                         if FINDINGS_WAIT > 0 else board.get("position"))
            findings = "\n".join(f"- position {k}: " + ", ".join(
                f"{f} {v}" for f, v in fact.value.items() if f.endswith("_key") or f == "condition_group")

                            ("setup_pools", "setup_pools"),

def build_bid(self) -> tuple[calc.BidInput, list[str]]:
        self.blank_hints = {}
        self.attributes = {}
        problems: list[str] = []
        clauses = None
        if self.tender_facts is not None and self.mail_facts is not None and research_mail is not None:
            try:
                clauses = research_mail.bid_clauses(self.tender_facts, self.mail_facts)
                problems += list(clauses.problems)
            except Exception as error:
                problems.append(f"bid clauses: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
        by_position = {c.position: c for c in getattr(clauses, "positions", [])}
        positions = []
        for p in getattr(self.tender_facts, "positions", []) or []:
            req_id = next((rid for rid in self.requirements if _same_id(rid, p.requirement)), None)
            if req_id is None:
                problems.append(f"position {p.position}: requirement {p.requirement} not read; position omitted")
                continue
            research = next((r for r in (self.erp.requirements if self.erp else []) if r.requirement_id == req_id),
                            None)
            # without a final choice (reselect cut short) the ERP worker's own choice stands
            number = self.chosen[req_id] if req_id in self.chosen else getattr(research, "selected", None)
            # a catalogue group the site itself reported empty is searched with no match (rule 3), not a gap
            empty_group = bool(getattr(research, "no_hits", False)) and not getattr(research, "inspected", None)
            if number is None and not empty_group and (research is None or not research.inspected):
                problems.append(f"position {p.position}: ERP not researched; position omitted")
                continue
            if number is None and not empty_group:
                # No material only means no_bid (rule 3) when the search for it was complete; a requirement still
                # pending (e.g. a reserve not found) or a search that hit problems leaves the position out instead.
                pending = self.effective(self.requirements[req_id]).pending
                estimate = self._estimate(req_id, research) if pending else None
                if estimate:
                    # Only here: no material was chosen (never replaces a choice) and the reserve is still unknown.
                    # The position was omitted before, not a no_bid, so the decision does not change either.
                    self.trace.event("calc", "stroke_estimate", position=p.position, requirement=req_id,
                                     material=estimate, pending="; ".join(pending)[:160])
                    problems.append(f"position {p.position}: {'; '.join(pending)[:120]}; material {estimate} "
                                    f"estimated (the closest stroke above the usable travel)")
                    number = estimate
                elif pending or (research is not None and research.problems):
                    problems.append(f"position {p.position}: material undecided "
                                    f"({'; '.join(pending or research.problems)[:160]}); position omitted")
                    continue
            material = self.erp.materials.get(number) if (number and self.erp) else None
            if number and material is None:  # chosen, but its record was not read: a gap, never "no material"
                problems.append(f"position {p.position}: record of {number} not read; position omitted")
                continue
            if material is not None:
                try:  # after amendments and the usable-travel derivation
                    wanted = self.effective(self.requirements[req_id])
                except Exception:
                    wanted = None
                self.attributes[p.position] = material_attributes(material, wanted)
            clause = by_position.get(p.position)
            self._unknown_clauses(p, clause, getattr(clauses, "setup_pools", None),
                                  getattr(clauses, "project_bonuses", None))
            extra = ({"discount_scope": clause.discount_scope, "setup_fee": clause.setup_fee,
                      "packaging": clause.packaging, "commitment": clause.commitment} if clause
                     else {"setup_fee": getattr(p, "setup_fee", Decimal(0))})
            pieces_per_set = self.effective(self.requirements[req_id]).pieces_per_set  # amended set size (rule 14)
            try:
                positions.append(to_position_input(p.position, p.quantity, p.unit, self.requirements[req_id],
                                                   material, pieces_per_set=pieces_per_set, **extra))
            except calc.CalcError as error:
                if material is not None:  # a reading gap (e.g. the unit): this position out, never "no material"
                    problems.append(f"position {p.position}: {error}; position omitted")
                    continue
                # no matching material, established: it carries the no_bid decision whatever its unit reads
                problems.append(f"position {p.position}: {error}")

        bid = calc.BidInput(tender_reference=self.reference, scenario_date=self.scenario_stamp, positions=positions,

                            fx_rates=getattr(clauses, "fx_rates", None) or getattr(self.mail_facts, "fx_rates", {}) or {},
                            metal_indices=getattr(clauses, "metal_indices", None)
                            or getattr(self.mail_facts, "metal_indices", {}) or {},
                            fx_per_eur=getattr(clauses, "fx_per_eur", None) or {},
                            setup_pools=getattr(clauses, "setup_pools", None) or [],
                            project_bonuses=getattr(clauses, "project_bonuses", None) or [])

        read that has them, Q&A answers from all (research_tender.combine). Two websites' reads used to overwrite
        each other, so Q&A on another website than the bill of quantities was lost.
        """
        self.tender_reads[read] = facts
        reads = list(self.tender_reads.values())
        combine = getattr(research_tender, "combine", None)
        self.tender_facts = combine(reads, self.scenario) if combine is not None and len(reads) > 1 else facts
        self._post_tender(self.tender_facts, site, session)

    def _post_tender(self, facts, site: str, session: SiteSession) -> None:
        board = self.board
        for p in facts.positions:
            value = {k: (str(v) if isinstance(v, Decimal) else v) for k, v in p.model_dump(mode="json").items()}
            board.post("position", p.position, value,
                       Source(site=site, url=session.page.url,
                              quote=quote_for(session.seen, p.position, str(p.tender_quantity))
                              or quote_for(session.seen, p.position)), "tender")
        for a in getattr(facts, "amendments", []):
            key = f"{a.revision}/{a.requirement}/{'+'.join(a.attributes)}"
            board.post("amendment", key, {"date": a.date.isoformat(), **{k: str(v) for k, v in a.attributes.items()}},
                       Source(site=site, quote=quote_for(session.seen, a.requirement,
                                                         *map(str, a.attributes.values()))), "tender")
        for number in getattr(facts, "withdrawn", []):
            board.post("withdrawn", number, number, Source(site=site, quote=quote_for(session.seen, number)),
                       "tender")

Atira Challenges CLI

Usage: atira <command> [options]   (or: node atira.mjs <command> [options])

Commands:
  login [--device] [--key <key>]
      Sign in through the browser (--device: with a code instead) and store a personal token, mode 0600; --key stores a team key where there is no GitHub sign-in
  logout
      Revoke the stored token on the server and forget it
  whoami
      Show who you are signed in as, your team and when the token expires
  token
      Print the token in use, for curl: curl -H "x-api-key: $(atira token)" ...
  upgrade
      Download the server's current CLI, check its SHA-256 and replace this file
  challenges
      List the challenges
  challenge <id>
      Print a challenge as Markdown: task, websites, rules, run contract, submitting, answer schema
  scout [--challenge <id>] [--env [--port <port>]]
      Print the published scouting logins for the public websites; --env prints shell exports (CHALLENGE_SCOUTING, CHALLENGE_SITE_ACCESS, each site's URL, and QWEN_BASE_URL, QWEN_API_KEY, CLEF_BASE_URL, CLEF_API_KEY pointed at atira models proxy) to run your agent locally against them
  models proxy [--port <port>]
      Run a local proxy on 127.0.0.1 (port 8765) to the free models, QWEN_BASE_URL and CLEF_BASE_URL: it prints the exports
  test-run <dir> [--challenge <id>] [--dry-run] [--follow] [--no-open]
      Pack <dir>, run it once in the sandbox on the public data and open its run page; --follow prints its place in the queue, then streams its logs here
  submit <dir> [--challenge <id>] [--dry-run] [--follow] [--no-open]
      Pack <dir> and submit it for a ranked run, public and final: review, then one scored run on the public dataset; opens the team page, which follows both; --follow prints the review, each run's place in the queue and its end here
  final [--best-of <1|3>] [--challenge <id>]
      Choose one final attempt or best of three before the final run starts; your own model keys cost up to 3×
  status [<id>] [--challenge <id>]
      Your latest submissions and test runs, or one submission (sub_), test run (reh_) or run (run_)
  logs <run> [--follow]
      Print a test or scored run's logs; --follow polls until the run has ended
  package <id> [--out <dir>]
      Show the package a test run (reh_ or run_), scored run or submission (sub_) of your team used, as uploaded: agent.json and each file's size; --out saves the .tar.gz in <dir>
  cancel <run>
      Cancel a test or scored run that has not finished: its sandbox is removed and the run fails
  leaderboard [--challenge <id>]
      Print the leaderboard
  eval <init|dev|deploy|preview|run|runs|board|ls|status|source|public|private|rm> ...
      Team evals: write the starter kit, run an eval here with local scoring, deploy it and get its live URLs, run your agent on it, see your runs and its leaderboard; atira eval --help lists each
  mcp
      Serve MCP on stdio, so a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ...) can list and debug your runs: why a run failed, logs by time, model calls, where the time went, a browser's screen at a time, recorded inputs, two runs compared, the package a run used; it can start and wait for test runs, and cancel a run or submit when you confirm

Options:
  --challenge, -c <id>  The challenge (default: ATIRA_CHALLENGE, else the platform's first)
  --json                Machine-readable output on stdout, errors included
  --help, -h            This help, or a command's (also: atira help <command>)
  --version, -v         This file's SHA-256, as install.sh printed it, and Node's version

Environment:
  ATIRA_API             The platform (default: https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai)
  ATIRA_TOKEN           A token to use instead of the one `login` stored
  ATIRA_CHALLENGE       The default challenge
  ATIRA_BROWSER         The command that opens pages (login, test-run, submit), or none to only print links

Exit codes:
  0 done   1 network or server error   2 usage   3 not signed in, or the credential was refused   4 not found
  5 invalid request or package   6 busy: a submission still in evaluation, three test runs already waiting, a rate limit, or a run that already finished
  7 the run failed or timed out (logs --follow, test-run --follow), or the submission did not complete (submit --follow)

Each event is one chunk: `id` is its cursor and `data` is `{"at", "stream", "text"}`. Reconnect with
`Last-Event-ID` (an `EventSource` does this by itself) or `?after=` to resume. A comment line (`: heartbeat`) comes
every 15 seconds; once the run has finished and everything is sent, an `end` event closes the stream, and connecting
again answers `204`. All of it at once, as JSON lines:

```sh
curl -o logs.jsonl "$ATIRA_API/v1/runs/$RUN_ID/logs.jsonl" -H "x-api-key: $ATIRA_TOKEN"
```

To look at one stretch of a run, query its lines by time and content. Times are on the run's clock, as the run page
shows them: `mm:ss`, `h:mm:ss`, `3m20s` or seconds from the run's start (a minus is before it), or an ISO 8601 time.

```sh
curl -G "$ATIRA_API/v1/runs/$RUN_ID/logs/query" -H "x-api-key: $ATIRA_TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode from=02:10 --data-urlencode to=02:40 --data-urlencode stream=stdout,stderr \
  --data-urlencode 'grep=error|timeout'
```

It answers `lines` (each with `t`, its milliseconds from the start, `clock` as `mm:ss.s`, `at`, `stream` and `text`),
`matched` and `next`: up to `limit` lines (200 by default, at most 1,000), and `next` to pass as `after` while more
match. `grep` is case-insensitive text; `a|b` matches either. The `input` stream holds the clicks, scrolls and typing
the platform recorded in each browser, one line per action (`browser 1: click at 640,412`). Typed text is shown, with
keys, tokens, your run's secrets and password or one-time-code fields masked. Lines come in time order across
streams. A click, drag or drop gives its point on the browser's 1280×800 display (Chrome's bar included) and, when
the platform knew the page's geometry, the same point in the page's viewport with the viewport's size:
`browser 1: click at 200,685 (viewport 200,542 of 1279x656)`. Frames and recordings show the viewport alone, so that
point lands on a frame at 200/1279 of its width and 542/656 of its height.

`GET /v1/runs/$RUN_ID/llm-calls` lists the run's model calls in order (`at`, `provider`, `model`, `status`, tokens,
`cost_micro_usd`, `latency_ms`, and `queue_ms`, how long a call to a hosted model waited for a GPU), up to `limit`
(2,000 by default) with `next` to pass as `after`. `GET /v1/runs/$RUN_ID/screen-activity` gives, per browser, the
spans during which its screen kept changing: a gap between spans is a time the screen sat still.

Runs on the public dataset (test runs and scored runs during the hackathon) keep their logs unredacted. On a
private dataset (the final run), your logs and the feed's `error` have private values masked as `[private]`.

"""
Tender research: the tender's positions with their original quantities, and everything the bidder Q&A changes.

A navigation worker (thinking off, so steps are fast) finds the tender on the bid website, picks the documents
that hold the bill of quantities and hands their links to `keep_pages`, which opens them and keeps their text. On
the bidder Q&A it hands the list's "next page" (or "load more") control to `collect_pages`, which pages through
that model-selected result set. Two readers (thinking on) then turn the kept pages into typed records, checked
against the pages, and `resolve_tender` applies the mechanical rules (latest dated answer per position and key,
withdrawn answers ignored, nothing after the scenario date) in calc's terms.
"""
import asyncio
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from typing import Literal
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_ai import Agent, ModelRetry, RunContext

import llm
from browser_tools import Deps, SiteSession, _click
from calc import (
    Amendment,
    CalcError,
    QuantityChange,
    Unit,
    norm_id,
    parse_unit,
    position_key,
    resolve_quantity,
)
from evidence import ParseError, parse_int, parse_number
from research import until_settled
from worker import run_worker, steps_for

MAX_PAGES = 40
MAX_RETURN = 30000  # characters of a collected list shown back to the model

class Collected:
    pages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    finished: bool = False  # collect_pages ran to the list's end
    finished_at: float | None = None  # time.monotonic() then
    mark: int | None = None  # len(session.seen) when collect_pages ended: later views are the worker's own

    def add(self, view: str) -> bool:
        """Keep a page view; False when it adds nothing new (past the end a list repeats a page it showed)."""
        new = _normal(view)
        earlier = [_normal(p) for p in self.pages]
        if new in earlier:
            return False
        if earlier and _content(earlier[-1]) <= _content(new):  # "load more" grew the list (its control moved)
            self.pages[-1] = view
            return True
        self.pages.append(view)
        return True

    def novel(self, text: str) -> list[str]:
        """Content lines of `text` that no kept page holds (refs ignored): what a view would add to the reading."""
        known = {line.strip() for p in self.pages for line in _normal(p).splitlines()}
        out = []
        for line in _normal(text).splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if line and line not in known and (any(c.isdigit() for c in line) or len(line) > 20):
                known.add(line)
                out.append(line)
        return out

    def reading(self, seen: str) -> list[str]:
        """
        The page views to read: the collected list, plus what the worker viewed itself after collect_pages (in
        one sandbox run the paging stopped at a page that had not rendered, the worker opened the remaining pages
        on its own, and only the collected ones were read: an amendment on the missed page was lost).
        """
        if not self.pages:
            return [seen]
        tail = seen[self.mark:] if self.mark is not None else ""
        extra = self.novel(tail)
        if extra:
            return [*self.pages, "=== further views the worker opened\n" + "\n".join(extra)]
        return list(self.pages)

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        return "\n\n".join(f"=== page view {i + 1}\n{p}" for i, p in enumerate(self.pages))


def _control(view: str, ref: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    for r, kind, name in REF_LINE.findall(view):
        if r == ref:
            return kind, name
    return None


def _target(view: str, ref: str) -> str | None:
    """The link target of control `ref`, when it is a link."""
    return next((href for r, _, href in LINK.findall(view) if r == ref), None)


def _loading(view: str, before: str) -> bool:
    """An embedded frame that has not rendered yet: the view shows it as separate where the earlier one did not."""
    return len(SEPARATE.findall(view)) > len(SEPARATE.findall(before))


EXPAND = ("() => { let n = 0; for (const d of document.querySelectorAll('details:not([open])')) "
          "{ d.open = true; n++; } return n; }")


async def expand_collapsed(page) -> int:
    """Open every collapsed <details> block in the page and its frames (answers shown only on demand); the
    number opened. Nothing else is clicked: a toggle that is a button may do anything."""
    opened = 0
    for frame in list(getattr(page, "frames", []) or []):
        try:
            opened += int(await asyncio.wait_for(frame.evaluate(EXPAND), 3.0) or 0)
        except Exception:  # a detached or busy frame
            continue
    return opened


async def _view_of(session: SiteSession, url: str) -> str | None:
    views = await open_and_keep(session, [url], [])
    return views[0] if views else None


async def follow_targets(session: SiteSession, collected: Collected, name: str, href: str | None) -> int:
    """
    The list's remaining pages by their link targets, each opened on its own in a temporary tab: for a list whose
    in-place page did not render after the click (an embedded frame still loading). A page is kept only when it
    shows answers no kept page holds; the next target is the link of the same name on the opened page.
    """
    pages, tried, base = 0, set(), session.page.url
    host = urlparse(base).netloc
    while href and pages < MAX_PAGES:
        url = urljoin(base, href)
        if url in tried or urlparse(url).netloc != host:
            break
        tried.add(url)
        view = await _view_of(session, url)
        if view is None or not collected.novel(view):
            break
        collected.pages.append(view)
        pages += 1
        base = url  # a page's own links are relative to it
        href = next((h for _, n, h in LINK.findall(view) if n == name), None)
    return pages


def paging_tool(collected: Collected, thorough: bool = False):
    """
    A tool that pages through the result set the model is looking at, by repeating the control it names. With
    `thorough` (the bidder Q&A, where one missed page can change the decision) collapsed <details> blocks are
    opened, a page whose embedded frame is still loading is waited for, and where the tab shows no further control
    the clicked link's target is opened on its own to tell the list's end from a page that did not render.
    """

    async def collect_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], next_ref: str) -> str:
        """Collect the whole list you are looking at: give the ref of its "next page" or "load more" control. The
        control is clicked until the list ends; every page is kept for reading afterwards. Call it once, on the
        list's first page."""
        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
        control = _control(session.view, next_ref)
        if control is None:
            return f"No control {next_ref} in the latest view; use a ref from the latest view."
        kind, name = control
        if thorough and await expand_collapsed(session.page):
            await session.look()
            same = [r for r, k, n in REF_LINE.findall(session.view) if k == kind and n == name]
            next_ref = same[0] if same else next_ref
        collected.add(session.view)
        ref, pages, followed = next_ref, 1, 0
        for _ in range(MAX_PAGES):
            before_view = session.view
            before = _normal(before_view)
            href = _target(before_view, ref)
            await session.act("click", ref, _click)
            # a list inside a frame can update a moment after the click settled, or show the frame still loading
            for _ in range(PAGE_WAITS if thorough else 4):
                if _normal(session.view) != before and not (thorough and _loading(session.view, before_view)):
                    break
                await asyncio.sleep(0.7)
                await session.look()
            if thorough and await expand_collapsed(session.page):
                await session.look()
            added = collected.add(session.view)
            same = [r for r, k, n in REF_LINE.findall(session.view) if k == kind and n == name]
            if added and same:
                pages += 1
                ref = same[0]
                continue
            if added:
                pages += 1
            # The tab shows no further control (or nothing new): the end of the list, or a page that did not
            # render. A link's target opened on its own tells which; its own next links carry on.
            if href and thorough:
                followed = await follow_targets(session, collected, name, href)
                pages += followed
            break
        collected.finished = True
        collected.finished_at = time.monotonic()
        collected.mark = len(session.seen)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "collect_pages", control=name, pages=len(collected.pages),
                            followed=followed)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "collected", quiet=True, pages=collected.pages)
        text = collected.text
        if len(text) > MAX_RETURN:
            text = text[:MAX_RETURN] + f"\n[... {len(text) - MAX_RETURN} more characters, kept for reading]"
        if not thorough:
            return f"Collected {pages} page(s) of this list; they are kept for reading. The whole list:\n\n{text}"
        return (f"Collected {pages} page(s) of this list, to its end; they are kept for reading. Return your "
                f"summary now: do not open the list's pages or answers again. The whole list:\n\n{text}")

    return collect_pages


async def open_and_keep(session: SiteSession, urls: list[str], kept: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Open each chosen URL in a temporary tab of the session's browser context, side by side, and keep its text."""

    async def one(url: str) -> str:
        tab = SiteSession(session.site, session.context, session.trace)
        page = await session.context.new_page()
        tab._watch(page)
        try:
            await tab._goto(url)
            await expand_collapsed(page)
            view = await tab.look()
            # An embedded document that did not render in place (e.g. a lazy reading pane) is part of the chosen
            # page: open it on its own and add its text.
            for src in EMPTY_FRAME.findall(view)[:3]:
                await tab._goto(urljoin(url, src))
                view += f"\n[frame {src} opened]\n" + await tab.look()
            return view
        finally:
            await page.close()

    views = await asyncio.gather(*(one(u) for u in urls), return_exceptions=True)
    good = [v for v in views if isinstance(v, str)]
    for view in good:
        kept.append(view)
        session.seen += "\n" + view
    return good


def _heads(views: list[str]) -> str:
    return "\n".join("- " + " / ".join(v.splitlines()[:2]) for v in views)


def keep_tool(kept: list[str]):
    """A tool that opens link targets the model chose, each in a temporary tab, and keeps their page text."""

    async def keep_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], targets: list[str]) -> str:
        """Open these links and keep each page for reading afterwards: give each link's target (the "-> ..." part)
        or its ref from the latest view. Pass every page you want at once; they open side by side. Your own tab
        stays where it is."""
        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
        host = urlparse(session.site["url"]).netloc

        def on_a_page(target: str) -> bool:  # chosen from a view, not made up
            url = urlparse(urljoin(session.page.url, target))
            local = url.path + (f"?{url.query}" if url.query else "")
            return target in session.seen or f"-> {local}" in session.seen or f"-> {url.geturl()}" in session.seen

        links = LINK.findall(session.view)
        hrefs = {ref: href for ref, _, href in links}  # a link's ref from the latest view stands for its target
        targets = [hrefs.get(t.strip(), t.strip()) for t in targets]
        shown = [t for t in targets if t and not REF.fullmatch(t) and on_a_page(t)]
        unknown = [t for t in targets if t.strip() and t.strip() not in shown]
        urls = list(dict.fromkeys(urljoin(session.page.url, t) for t in shown))
        urls = [u for u in urls if urlparse(u).netloc == host][:25]
        good = await open_and_keep(session, urls, kept)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "keep_pages", targets=urls, unknown=unknown, kept=len(good))
        answer = f"Kept {len(good)} of {len(urls)} page(s):\n{_heads(good)}"
        if unknown:
            listing = "\n".join(f"  {ref}: {href}" for ref, _, href in links[:40])
            answer += (f"\nNot opened, these targets appear on no page you have seen: {unknown[:10]}. Use link "
                       f"targets exactly as the views show them. Links in the latest view:\n{listing}")
        return answer

    return keep_pages


def _clean(text: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(text.split()).casefold()


def keep_results_tool(kept: list[str]):
    """A tool that opens the result links whose visible text the model names, from every list the worker saw."""

    async def keep_results(ctx: RunContext[Deps], link_texts: list[str]) -> str:
        """Open every result link whose visible text is exactly one of `link_texts` (e.g. a message subject as a
        result list shows it), from all result lists you have seen (all folders and pages), and keep each opened
        page for reading. Copy the texts exactly: a text with any extra characters is a different record."""
        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
        host = urlparse(session.site["url"]).netloc
        wanted = {_clean(t) for t in link_texts if t.strip()}
        hits = [href for _, text, href in LINK.findall(session.seen) if _clean(text) in wanted]
        urls = list(dict.fromkeys(urljoin(session.site["url"], h) for h in hits))
        urls = [u for u in urls if urlparse(u).netloc == host][:20]
        good = await open_and_keep(session, urls, kept)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "keep_results", texts=link_texts, urls=urls, kept=len(good))
        if not urls:
            texts = sorted({text for _, text, _ in LINK.findall(session.view)})[:40]
            return (f"No link seen with exactly these texts: {link_texts}. Link texts in the latest view: {texts}")
        return f"Kept {len(good)} of {len(urls)} result page(s):\n{_heads(good)}"

    return keep_results


def _goal(reference: str) -> str:
    return f"""For tender {reference} (exactly this reference; similar references are other tenders):

class Collected:
    pages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    finished: bool = False  # collect_pages ran to the list's end
    finished_at: float | None = None  # time.monotonic() then
    mark: int | None = None  # len(session.seen) when collect_pages ended: later views are the worker's own

    def add(self, view: str) -> bool:
        """Keep a page view; False when it adds nothing new (past the end a list repeats a page it showed)."""
        new = _normal(view)
        earlier = [_normal(p) for p in self.pages]
        if new in earlier:
            return False
        if earlier and _content(earlier[-1]) <= _content(new):  # "load more" grew the list (its control moved)
            self.pages[-1] = view
            return True
        self.pages.append(view)
        return True

    def novel(self, text: str) -> list[str]:
        """Content lines of `text` that no kept page holds (refs ignored): what a view would add to the reading."""
        known = {line.strip() for p in self.pages for line in _normal(p).splitlines()}
        out = []
        for line in _normal(text).splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if line and line not in known and (any(c.isdigit() for c in line) or len(line) > 20):
                known.add(line)
                out.append(line)
        return out

    def reading(self, seen: str) -> list[str]:
        """
        The page views to read: the collected list, plus what the worker viewed itself after collect_pages (in
        one sandbox run the paging stopped at a page that had not rendered, the worker opened the remaining pages
        on its own, and only the collected ones were read: an amendment on the missed page was lost).
        """
        if not self.pages:
            return [seen]
        tail = seen[self.mark:] if self.mark is not None else ""
        extra = self.novel(tail)
        if extra:
            return [*self.pages, "=== further views the worker opened\n" + "\n".join(extra)]
        return list(self.pages)

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        return "\n\n".join(f"=== page view {i + 1}\n{p}" for i, p in enumerate(self.pages))


def _control(view: str, ref: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    for r, kind, name in REF_LINE.findall(view):
        if r == ref:
            return kind, name
    return None


def _target(view: str, ref: str) -> str | None:
    """The link target of control `ref`, when it is a link."""
    return next((href for r, _, href in LINK.findall(view) if r == ref), None)


def _loading(view: str, before: str) -> bool:
    """An embedded frame that has not rendered yet: the view shows it as separate where the earlier one did not."""
    return len(SEPARATE.findall(view)) > len(SEPARATE.findall(before))


EXPAND = ("() => { let n = 0; for (const d of document.querySelectorAll('details:not([open])')) "
          "{ d.open = true; n++; } return n; }")


async def expand_collapsed(page) -> int:
    """Open every collapsed <details> block in the page and its frames (answers shown only on demand); the
    number opened. Nothing else is clicked: a toggle that is a button may do anything."""
    opened = 0
    for frame in list(getattr(page, "frames", []) or []):
        try:
            opened += int(await asyncio.wait_for(frame.evaluate(EXPAND), 3.0) or 0)
        except Exception:  # a detached or busy frame
            continue
    return opened


async def _view_of(session: SiteSession, url: str) -> str | None:
    views = await open_and_keep(session, [url], [])
    return views[0] if views else None


async def follow_targets(session: SiteSession, collected: Collected, name: str, href: str | None) -> int:
    """
    The list's remaining pages by their link targets, each opened on its own in a temporary tab: for a list whose
    in-place page did not render after the click (an embedded frame still loading). A page is kept only when it
    shows answers no kept page holds; the next target is the link of the same name on the opened page.
    """
    pages, tried, base = 0, set(), session.page.url
    host = urlparse(base).netloc
    while href and pages < MAX_PAGES:
        url = urljoin(base, href)
        if url in tried or urlparse(url).netloc != host:
            break
        tried.add(url)
        view = await _view_of(session, url)
        if view is None or not collected.novel(view):
            break
        collected.pages.append(view)
        pages += 1
        base = url  # a page's own links are relative to it
        href = next((h for _, n, h in LINK.findall(view) if n == name), None)
    return pages


def paging_tool(collected: Collected, thorough: bool = False):
    """
    A tool that pages through the result set the model is looking at, by repeating the control it names. With
    `thorough` (the bidder Q&A, where one missed page can change the decision) collapsed <details> blocks are
    opened, a page whose embedded frame is still loading is waited for, and where the tab shows no further control
    the clicked link's target is opened on its own to tell the list's end from a page that did not render.
    """

    async def collect_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], next_ref: str) -> str:
        """Collect the whole list you are looking at: give the ref of its "next page" or "load more" control. The
        control is clicked until the list ends; every page is kept for reading afterwards. Call it once, on the
        list's first page."""
        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
        control = _control(session.view, next_ref)
        if control is None:
            return f"No control {next_ref} in the latest view; use a ref from the latest view."
        kind, name = control
        if thorough and await expand_collapsed(session.page):
            await session.look()
            same = [r for r, k, n in REF_LINE.findall(session.view) if k == kind and n == name]
            next_ref = same[0] if same else next_ref
        collected.add(session.view)
        ref, pages, followed = next_ref, 1, 0
        for _ in range(MAX_PAGES):
            before_view = session.view
            before = _normal(before_view)
            href = _target(before_view, ref)
            await session.act("click", ref, _click)
            # a list inside a frame can update a moment after the click settled, or show the frame still loading
            for _ in range(PAGE_WAITS if thorough else 4):
                if _normal(session.view) != before and not (thorough and _loading(session.view, before_view)):
                    break
                await asyncio.sleep(0.7)
                await session.look()
            if thorough and await expand_collapsed(session.page):
                await session.look()
            added = collected.add(session.view)
            same = [r for r, k, n in REF_LINE.findall(session.view) if k == kind and n == name]
            if added and same:
                pages += 1
                ref = same[0]
                continue
            if added:
                pages += 1
            # The tab shows no further control (or nothing new): the end of the list, or a page that did not
            # render. A link's target opened on its own tells which; its own next links carry on.
            if href and thorough:
                followed = await follow_targets(session, collected, name, href)
                pages += followed
            break
        collected.finished = True
        collected.finished_at = time.monotonic()
        collected.mark = len(session.seen)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "collect_pages", control=name, pages=len(collected.pages),
                            followed=followed)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "collected", quiet=True, pages=collected.pages)
        text = collected.text
        if len(text) > MAX_RETURN:
            text = text[:MAX_RETURN] + f"\n[... {len(text) - MAX_RETURN} more characters, kept for reading]"
        if not thorough:
            return f"Collected {pages} page(s) of this list; they are kept for reading. The whole list:\n\n{text}"
        return (f"Collected {pages} page(s) of this list, to its end; they are kept for reading. Return your "
                f"summary now: do not open the list's pages or answers again. The whole list:\n\n{text}")

    return collect_pages


async def open_and_keep(session: SiteSession, urls: list[str], kept: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Open each chosen URL in a temporary tab of the session's browser context, side by side, and keep its text."""

    async def one(url: str) -> str:
        tab = SiteSession(session.site, session.context, session.trace)
        page = await session.context.new_page()
        tab._watch(page)
        try:
            await tab._goto(url)
            await expand_collapsed(page)
            view = await tab.look()
            # An embedded document that did not render in place (e.g. a lazy reading pane) is part of the chosen
            # page: open it on its own and add its text.
            for src in EMPTY_FRAME.findall(view)[:3]:
                await tab._goto(urljoin(url, src))
                view += f"\n[frame {src} opened]\n" + await tab.look()
            return view
        finally:
            await page.close()

    views = await asyncio.gather(*(one(u) for u in urls), return_exceptions=True)
    good = [v for v in views if isinstance(v, str)]
    for view in good:
        kept.append(view)
        session.seen += "\n" + view
    return good

def _numbers(text: str) -> set[Decimal]:
    found: set[Decimal] = set()
    for token in re.findall(r"\d[\d.,]*", text):
        token = token.rstrip(".,")
        for candidate in (token.replace(",", "."), token.replace(".", "").replace(",", "."), token.replace(",", "")):
            try:
                found.add(Decimal(candidate))
            except InvalidOperation:
                pass
    return found


def ungrounded(record: BaseModel, text: str, skip: tuple[str, ...] = ("date",)) -> list[str]:
    """Values in a record (numbers, keys) that the source text does not contain; dates are not checked."""
    numbers = _numbers(text)
    flat = " ".join(text.split())
    missing: list[str] = []

    def check(value, name: str) -> None:
        if name in skip or value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, datetime)):
            return
        if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
            for k, v in value:
                check(v, k)
        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            for v in value:
                check(v, name)
        elif isinstance(value, dict):
            for k, v in value.items():
                check(v, str(k))
        elif isinstance(value, (int, Decimal, float)):
            if Decimal(str(value)) not in numbers:
                missing.append(f"{name}={value}")
        elif isinstance(value, str) and any(c.isdigit() for c in value):
            if " ".join(value.split()) not in flat and not (_numbers(value) and _numbers(value) <= numbers):
                missing.append(f"{name}={value!r}")

    check(record, "")
    return missing


def reader_model():
    """The run's model; readers get their longer deadline per call from reader_settings()."""
    return llm.model()


def reader_settings():
    """Thinking on, with a whole-call deadline long enough for readers that write long typed answers."""
    return llm.settings(thinking=True, timeout=READER_TIMEOUT)


async def _read(output_type, instructions: str, text: str, prompt: str, thinking: bool = True):
    settings = reader_settings() if thinking else llm.settings(thinking=False)
    agent = Agent(reader_model(), output_type=output_type, instructions=instructions,
                  model_settings=settings, retries=3)

    @agent.output_validator
    def _grounded(records):
        missing = ungrounded(records, text)
        if missing:
            raise ModelRetry(f"These values are not in the pages: {', '.join(missing[:12])}. Copy values exactly.")
        return records

    return (await agent.run(f"{prompt}\n\n{text}")).output


async def read_positions(text: str, reference: str) -> TenderPositions:
    """
    The positions, thinking on, within POSITIONS_READ_SECONDS in all: in one sandbox run the reader's calls kept
    timing out and retrying from 137 s to the research deadline, so no position reached the bid. After that
    bound, one thinking-off read (short answers, fast) within POSITIONS_FALLBACK_SECONDS.
    """
    prompt = f"Tender {reference}. Documents:"
    try:
        return await asyncio.wait_for(_read(TenderPositions, POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS, text, prompt),
                                      POSITIONS_READ_SECONDS)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        print(f"[tender] positions reader still busy after {POSITIONS_READ_SECONDS:g} s; reading once thinking off",
              flush=True)
    return await asyncio.wait_for(_read(TenderPositions, POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS, text, prompt, thinking=False),
                                  POSITIONS_FALLBACK_SECONDS)


async def read_qa_page(page: str, reference: str) -> QaPage:
    """
    One page view, checked for completeness: answers the reader lists but records no fact for are read once
    more (in one sandbox run the three newest answers of a long view, a withdrawal and two positions' keys, were
    missing from the records although every kept view showed them).
    """
    prompt = f"Tender {reference}. Bidder Q&A page:"
    part = await _read(QaPage, QA_INSTRUCTIONS, page, prompt)
    missing = unrecorded(part)
    if not missing:

def _numbers(text: str) -> set[Decimal]:
    found: set[Decimal] = set()
    for token in re.findall(r"\d[\d.,]*", text):
        token = token.rstrip(".,")
        for candidate in (token.replace(",", "."), token.replace(".", "").replace(",", "."), token.replace(",", "")):
            try:
                found.add(Decimal(candidate))
            except InvalidOperation:
                pass
    return found


def ungrounded(record: BaseModel, text: str, skip: tuple[str, ...] = ("date",)) -> list[str]:
    """Values in a record (numbers, keys) that the source text does not contain; dates are not checked."""
    numbers = _numbers(text)
    flat = " ".join(text.split())
    missing: list[str] = []

    def check(value, name: str) -> None:
        if name in skip or value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, datetime)):
            return
        if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
            for k, v in value:
                check(v, k)
        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            for v in value:
                check(v, name)
        elif isinstance(value, dict):
            for k, v in value.items():
                check(v, str(k))
        elif isinstance(value, (int, Decimal, float)):
            if Decimal(str(value)) not in numbers:
                missing.append(f"{name}={value}")
        elif isinstance(value, str) and any(c.isdigit() for c in value):
            if " ".join(value.split()) not in flat and not (_numbers(value) and _numbers(value) <= numbers):
                missing.append(f"{name}={value!r}")

    check(record, "")
    return missing


def reader_model():
    """The run's model; readers get their longer deadline per call from reader_settings()."""
    return llm.model()


def reader_settings():
    """Thinking on, with a whole-call deadline long enough for readers that write long typed answers."""
    return llm.settings(thinking=True, timeout=READER_TIMEOUT)


async def _read(output_type, instructions: str, text: str, prompt: str, thinking: bool = True):
    settings = reader_settings() if thinking else llm.settings(thinking=False)
    agent = Agent(reader_model(), output_type=output_type, instructions=instructions,
                  model_settings=settings, retries=3)

    @agent.output_validator
    def _grounded(records):
        missing = ungrounded(records, text)
        if missing:
            raise ModelRetry(f"These values are not in the pages: {', '.join(missing[:12])}. Copy values exactly.")
        return records

    return (await agent.run(f"{prompt}\n\n{text}")).output


async def read_positions(text: str, reference: str) -> TenderPositions:
    """
    The positions, thinking on, within POSITIONS_READ_SECONDS in all: in one sandbox run the reader's calls kept
    timing out and retrying from 137 s to the research deadline, so no position reached the bid. After that
    bound, one thinking-off read (short answers, fast) within POSITIONS_FALLBACK_SECONDS.
    """
    prompt = f"Tender {reference}. Documents:"
    try:
        return await asyncio.wait_for(_read(TenderPositions, POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS, text, prompt),
                                      POSITIONS_READ_SECONDS)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        print(f"[tender] positions reader still busy after {POSITIONS_READ_SECONDS:g} s; reading once thinking off",

    return await asyncio.wait_for(_read(TenderPositions, POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS, text, prompt, thinking=False),
